_note: One entry per research document. 'theme' is its single primary tag: one of the ids in 'themes' (labels live in research-i18n.json). 'slug' = file name in research/, 'pdf' = path from the site root. The order here is the order on the page: newest first, so put a new document at the top. "new": true gives a document the blue "New" chip; remove it when it is no longer new. "date" (YYYY-MM-DD) is shown on the card before the "New" chip; taken from each PDF's creation date, edit it to the publication date. "people" maps an author's name, as written in "authors", to the file name (without .html) of that scientist in expert/; such a name is a link to the profile on the card and on the document page. Add a name there when the author is on the site.
